fields.label: Run Docling
fields.help: Convert PDF pages to markdown using the Docling library.

fields.label: Run TOC Fixer
fields.help: Post-process the converted markdown to create proper headings from the extracted table of contents (toc.json).

fields.label: Run Code Fixer
fields.help: Add language identifiers to fenced code blocks and pretty-print the code.

fields.label: Run PDF Trim
fields.help: Remove unwanted pages from the PDF and save the table of contents as toc.json before conversion.

fields.label: Remove Front Pages
fields.help: Number of pages to remove from the beginning of the PDF (e.g. title page). 0-based: the first page is page 0.

fields.label: TOC Range
fields.readOnlyReason: Python tuple expression. Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: 1-based inclusive page range to extract as the table of contents, stored as a Python tuple (start, end).

fields.label: Remove Ranges
fields.readOnlyReason: Python list-of-tuples expression. Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: List of (start, end) page ranges to remove from the PDF. Multiple ranges are allowed, e.g. [(4, 12), (217, 234)].

fields.label: Remove Back Pages
fields.help: Number of pages to remove from the end of the PDF.
